WIDE CINEMATIC VISTA — establishing shot, eye-level horizon centered on lower third, sky and atmosphere fill upper two-thirds. Full depth visible from foreground to deep horizon. The kind of frame a film opens with.
EXTREME LOW ANGLE LOOKING UP — camera at ground level tilted upward, foreground tilted forward, sky filled with the impossible structure or formation. Forces vertical scale impression.
AERIAL SWEEP — high-altitude oblique, camera moving over the terrain, structures and landscape revealed from above. Helicopter-pull-back compositional energy.
LONG-LENS DEEP COMPRESSION — telephoto flattening layers, foreground / mid / deep all visible but stacked, atmospheric haze separating each depth band. Anchor entity is mid-distance silhouette.
WORM'S-EYE FROM RIDGE EDGE — foreground is a near cliff or terrace edge, midground falls away into the deep scene, far horizon glimpsed across the void. Vertigo composition.
OVER-THE-SHOULDER ANCHOR — anchor entity in foreground (back-turned), the wonder of the scene unfolding ahead of them. Caspar-Friedrich / Spielberg awe-pose.
DUTCH-TILT CHAOS — frame tilted 15-25 degrees, unsettled energy, used for THREAT or CONVERGENCE beats. Dramatic instability built into the composition.
BIRD'S-EYE TOP-DOWN — straight overhead view, the landscape reads as map-like, anchor entity is a tiny silhouette near center. Best for showing pattern and density.
SYMMETRIC HERO FRAME — anchor entity or structure centered on the vertical axis, environment symmetric to both sides, monumental balance. Used for ARRIVAL or VIGIL.
RACKED FOREGROUND — sharp tangible foreground element (railing, machinery, ruined stone) leading the eye into a soft-focus deep scene. Strong depth via focus contrast.
PROFILE PARALLAX — anchor entity in clean profile against a layered environment receding sideways, three depth bands visible (near terrain, mid-feature, far horizon).
BACKLIT SILHOUETTE — strong light source behind the anchor entity, scene rendered in heavy chiaroscuro, atmosphere visible in the light beam. Mood: sacred or threatening.
